quests.hint: Notice the vowel length: 'ship' uses a short, relaxed /ɪ/, while 'sheep' stretches the same vowel position into a long, tense /iː/.
quests.explanation: The speaker said "ship." The vowel is short and lax - say it quickly without tensing your lips. "Sheep" would hold that vowel much longer, with slightly spread lips.
quests.vowelTensionRule: Short /ɪ/ is relaxed and quick. Long /iː/ requires tensing the tongue and holding the sound longer (like a slight smile).
